newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends easier on strike worries.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends easier on strike worries.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker, weighed down by market fears of a strike called by the opposition for Thursday, dealers said.

The currency closed at 43.7480/7530 to the dollar against Tuesday's 43.7400/7450 close. It briefly flirted with the 43.7450 level before importers unloaded taka and bought dollars ahead of the planned strike.
The main opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party has called the strike to protest taxes in the 1997/98 budget, which parliament passed earlier this week.
Interbank call money rates closed at six to seven percent, slightly softer than Tuesday's 6.5-7.5 percent.
